With years of teaching experience and a focus on international students, every lesson is adapted to your skills, confidence and individual goals. FAQ.title: Everything you need to know
FAQ.description: Answers to common questions about driving lessons, prices and the practical exam.

experience.question: I already have driving experience. Will I need many lessons?
experience.answer: It depends on your current skills. During the first lesson, the instructor can assess your driving and identify what you need to work on for the Dutch practical exam.

english.question: Can I take driving lessons in English?
english.answer: Yes, driving lessons are also available in English.

duration.question: How long is a driving lesson?
duration.answer: Lessons are available in 60-minute and 90-minute formats. You can discuss the most suitable duration with your instructor.

package.question: Do I have to purchase a lesson package?
package.answer: No, individual lessons are also available. There is also a discounted package of ten 90-minute lessons.

exam.question: When can I take my practical exam?
exam.answer: This depends on your driving skills and available CBR exam dates. Your instructor can help you decide when you are ready.

anxiety.question: Is there support for driving test anxiety?
anxiety.answer: The CBR offers a special practical exam for performance anxiety. Discuss the most suitable guidance and exam option with your instructor.
